description: This file defines the TextFragment class for an Android application, handling fragment view creation, click listener setup, and custom animation behavior including animation end callback.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass responsible for inflating its view, handling click events, and providing custom entrance and exit animations with callback notification on animation end.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and sets up the click listener for the view.

methods.name: setClickListener
methods.description: Assigns a click listener to handle click events within the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateAnimator
methods.description: Creates and returns an Animator object for fragment transitions, attaching an end listener if entering.

methods.name: setOnTextFragmentAnimationEnd
methods.description: Sets a listener to be invoked when the fragment's animation ends.
